# OpenDevGuild 0.4.1 — maintenance prerelease

This new bundle includes the fixes merged after 0.4.0. The old release/tag/assets
remain available and unchanged. Base before release preparation:
`b4bbb18523afd4be83937572c04457925cb95961`.

## Included changes

- [PR #3](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/pull/3): conservative local test preflight; it does not replace full CI.
- [PR #4](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/pull/4): isolated offline client fixture; preparation is not model activation.
- [PR #5](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/pull/5): reject linked ancestors and detect added dangling links.
- [PR #6](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/pull/6): bounded regular-file inputs, controlled malformed/deep/duplicate manifest errors.
- [PR #7](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/pull/7): scope authorization provenance and frozen matched development inputs, with no fabricated outcomes.
- [PR #8](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/pull/8): stage and verify whole installer batches before retirement, compensate recoverable errors, preserve originals and block ordinary operations while recovery is pending; add explicit whole-batch `recover`.
- [PR #9](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/pull/9): retain both source and destination test coverage across Git renames.

Preserved: 34 core skills + 8 visual specialists = **42 skills**, **8 optional
Codex profiles**, Visual Intelligence Engine V1 and Apache-2.0 licensing.
No new dependencies, model runtime, global configuration or account setup.

## Download and start / Descarga y uso

Download **both** `opendevguild-0.4.1.zip` and `opendevguild-0.4.1.zip.sha256`
from this release. Linux: `sha256sum -c opendevguild-0.4.1.zip.sha256`;
macOS: `shasum -a 256 -c opendevguild-0.4.1.zip.sha256`. Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
$expected = (Get-Content .\opendevguild-0.4.1.zip.sha256).Split()[0].ToLowerInvariant()
$actual = (Get-FileHash .\opendevguild-0.4.1.zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
if ($actual -ne $expected) { throw 'SHA-256 mismatch: do not install' }
```

Extract the reviewed ZIP and copy only a selected complete skill folder into your
client's documented discovery path; refuse existing destinations. Manual use
needs no Python or contributor environment. Client authentication and actual
discovery/activation are separate requirements, not established by copying files.

- README: [ES](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/blob/v0.4.1/README.es.md) / [EN](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/blob/v0.4.1/README.md)
- Installation: [ES](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/blob/v0.4.1/docs/installation.es.md) / [EN](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/blob/v0.4.1/docs/installation.md)
- Quick usage: [ES](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/blob/v0.4.1/docs/quickstart.es.md) / [EN](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/blob/v0.4.1/docs/quickstart.md)
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/blob/v0.4.1/docs/troubleshooting.md), [compatibility](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/blob/v0.4.1/docs/client-compatibility.md), [examples](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/blob/v0.4.1/docs/usage-examples.md), [installer/recovery EN+ES](https://github.com/kkshiiit/opendevguild/blob/v0.4.1/docs/installer-reference.md)

For the optional Python installer, choose a new project target and inspect the
dry-run first (substitute your project path):

```text
python scripts/install.py install --target /path/to/your-app/.agents/skills --skill scope-guardian --dry-run
python scripts/install.py install --target /path/to/your-app/.agents/skills --skill scope-guardian
```

Once the client actually discovers the skill, try:
`$scope-guardian Define the scope of a bug fix. Do not edit files.`
If `pending.json` remains after an I/O failure, stop ordinary operations, resolve
the underlying problem and inspect whole-batch recovery:

```text
python scripts/install.py recover --target /path/to/your-app/.agents/skills --dry-run
python scripts/install.py recover --target /path/to/your-app/.agents/skills
```

Español: descargá ZIP y checksum, verificá antes de extraer y elegí una skill.
Instalar carpetas no demuestra activación. Si hay estado pendiente, detené nuevas
operaciones y revisá `recover` para el lote completo. No borres backups, journals
ni manifiestos para eludir controles. Actualización y desinstalación se documentan
en las guías; cambios del usuario bloquean sobrescrituras.

## Verification and limits

Release gates require official skill/profile validation, fatal lint, complete
unittest and hosted Linux (3.11/3.12), Windows, macOS and Chromium checks, two
identical archive builds, extracted archive lifecycle/recovery tests, and actual
anonymous ZIP/checksum downloads with native checks on all three operating systems.
Observed publication SHA/hash/size and workflow results are appended to the public
release after execution; a planned URL alone is not proof of publication.

The installer preserves originals and the exact prior manifest on tested
recoverable errors. If restoration fails, pending state blocks ordinary operations.
If cleanup fails after commit, the new batch remains committed and recovery only
finishes cleanup. Rollback consumes history; it is not redo.

**Limits:** no power-loss/fsync durability, reader isolation, concurrent-writer,
hostile-race or arbitrary-filesystem guarantee. Persistent I/O errors, corruption
or damaged unsigned recovery state can need reviewed manual recovery. Native
client/model/subagent execution remains **NOT_RUN / BLOCKED_BY_AUTH**; remote
login was not retried. No new human/native-app benchmark, aesthetic advantage,
token saving, compliance certification or fine-tuning is claimed.
